📘 Day 1 — Arrays & Lists Practice

Lists • Beginner Questions • VSCode • LeetCode

🐍 Step 1: Choose Language

Recommended: Python

Before solving problems, first understand how Python lists work.

Python Lists Documentation

Read the documentation once, then immediately try things yourself.

🐞 Step 2 • VS Code Debugging Practice

Try solving or testing your solutions using the VS Code debugger.

You can inspect variables and watch execution step-by-step.

  • F10 → Step Over
  • F11 → Step Into
  • Shift + F11 → Step Out
  • Watch how variables change line-by-line.
  • Observe loops, indexes and conditions carefully.

💻 Step 3: Open VS Code & Explore Lists

Spend some time experimenting before touching problems.

  • Create lists
  • Access elements using indexing
  • Modify values
  • Use loops with lists
  • Use conditions with lists
  • Nested loops
  • append()
  • pop()
  • remove()
  • sort()
  • reverse()
  • len()
  • in operator
  • List slicing

🧩 Step 4 • Beginner Array / List Questions

Do these simple questions first before LeetCode.

  1. Create a list containing these 5 fruits: Apple, Mango, Banana, Orange, Grapes. Print the first, third, and last fruit.
  2. Create a list of student marks: 45, 78, 91, 34, 88, 62, 55, 29. Replace the lowest mark with 100.
  3. Create a shopping list containing: Milk, Bread, Eggs, Rice, Soap, Apples. Add Cheese and Coffee, then remove Apples.
  4. Create a list of ages: 12, 17, 18, 21, 15, 30, 42, 16, 19, 25. Count how many ages are 18 or older.
  5. Create a list of cities: Tokyo, Mumbai, Paris, London, Seoul, Sydney, Dubai. Check whether "Tokyo" exists.
  6. Create a list of temperatures: 28.5, 31.2, 26.8, 33.0, 29.4, 35.1, 27.9, 30.6. Find highest, lowest, and average.
  7. Create a list of numbers: 25, 10, 25, 44, 18, 25, 91, 44, 72, 25, 10, 60. Count how many times 25 appears.
  8. Create two movie lists: ["Inception", "Interstellar", "Dune", "The Matrix"] and ["Avatar", "Titanic", "Joker", "Oppenheimer"]. Merge them.
  9. Create a username list: alex21, sam_dev, alex21, maya07, sam_dev, john99, maya07, nova88. Remove duplicate usernames.
  10. Create a programming language list: Python, Java, C++, Rust, Go, JavaScript. Sort alphabetically, then reverse the sorted list.

🔥 Step 5 • LeetCode Practice

Rules:

  • Spend 30 minutes minimum per problem.
  • If you don't even reach a brute force approach → refer to solution.
  • If you solve it → still review other approaches,Read Discussion tab,Solutions tab of the problem,Compare runtimes after submission with others see if u can find better ones and see what made others code better than yours and what made their code worse.
